episodeText:
USER: My Postgres queries are getting slow on the orders table.
AGENT: How big is the table?
USER: 50 million rows. We have an index on customer_id but not on created_at.
AGENT: Composite index might help. Do you query both columns together?
USER: Yes, always with date range filters.

expectedFacts.text: Orders Postgres table has 50 million rows
Existing index on orders.customer_id but not on created_at
Queries filter on both customer_id and date range simultaneously
